source.title: Department 2 — Catalyst Core, Auth & Data Security
source.body:
## Mission
Stabilize and secure exactly **one existing Catalyst backend**: project 17990000000237407, function mf_zoho_gateway. This is a coordination issue; do not create or deploy a parallel backend.
## Current observed blockers (2026-10-12)
Gateway registered but metadata says `is_deployed=false`; code in GitHub PR #14 and #23 is draft/not merged into authoritative live source. Sensitive credentials are present as readable Catalyst function environment values. Previous audits reported overbroad Datastore App User access. Treat all as release blockers.
## P0 tasks
- Recover and diff actual current function/client source; branch carefully and produce SHA/source manifest (#15).
- Audit and rotate exposed/old secrets through secure administrative flow without copying secrets into issues/chats/logs; remove secret leakage from all tool-facing logs and traces.
- Audit/lock tenant/customer/outlet access, role-based permissions, session boundaries, webhook signature verification, atomic idempotency/replay handling, Datastore ACL least privilege (#16).
- Validate Development API Gateway auth protected paths, deployed function/web client build, health, error handling, trace IDs, rollback (#17).
- Keep credit mode OBSERVE and production writes gated until pilot passes.
## Done only when
Verified Development gateway release identifier, green tests (including cross-tenant probes), confirmed source equivalence, credential/ACL review evidence, and tested sign-in/profile/logout/role boundaries; owner approval for any production promotion.
## Links
#15 #16 #17 #20; draft PRs #14 and #23.

comments.author: yasirkolathur
comments.text:
Department 2 verification — 2026-10-12 (Development only; no production deployment)

**Project/runtime inspected:** menafoodscustomermiddleware `17990000000237407`, sole listed function `mf_zoho_gateway` / `17990000000231926` (Node 24). Catalyst reports `is_deployed=false`; no verified live deployment receipt or source equivalence. All five backend API entries resolve to that existing function.

**Private source recovery:** original v12.3.23 gateway ZIP SHA-256 `5d3cf524477708a37fc147e42e914bddf98dec62d26f33ced5b0631088c703d9`; newer private staging cannot be asserted equal to current runtime. Offline baseline: `npm test` 165/165. A locally staged v12.3.24 *candidate* patches fail-open SalesIQ webhook signature checking (missing secret -> fail closed, invalid signature -> reject) and adds two regressions; `npm run check && npm test` 167/167. Staged candidate SHA-256 `c6e51d7213d2201c04b4e1f9af093b08882eb66df4317802cd7da1bf2cd4c1b7`. Private source was **not** pushed to public GitHub or uploaded to Catalyst.

**Development Datastore ACLs fixed and read-back verified 14/14:** Removed global App User SELECT from `MF_Webhook_Events`, `MF_Customer_Branches`, `MF_Supplier_Quotes`, `MF_Business_Locations`, `MF_Deliveries`, `MF_Delivery_Events`, `MF_Drivers`, `MF_Favourites`, `MF_Account_Managers`, `MF_App_Settings`, `MF_Supplier_Fulfilments`, `MF_Sourcing_Recommendations`, `MF_Sourcing_Requests`, `MF_Supplier_Capabilities`. Preserved App Administrator privileges. Public-oriented `MF_Product_Category_Map` unchanged pending field/security review. Test signed-in client flows after ACL changes; direct Datastore client readers may now be denied as intended.

**Review:** PR #14 head `9ebaa132c15c42785ff2442755e039cd1b19ff3a` and PR #23 head `dc7a56d30c3a3e33a5f1270688ac906409a9cb3a` both remain drafts/unmerged. Their GitHub CI checks passed at those SHAs; this proves only scaffold test status, not runtime security. No new commit, PR merge, second backend, Replit, Books write or secret rotation.

**RELEASE BLOCKED:** (1) secure source-to-runtime diff and deployment receipt; (2) metadata surfaces credential values: authorize a controlled secret rotation without publishing values; (3) SalesIQ fail-closed fix not deployed; (4) authenticated Development cross-tenant, branch, logout, role and webhook probes, including after ACL changes; (5) durable idempotency/exactly-one Books order pilot & rollback receipt. `MF_CREDIT_ENFORCEMENT_MODE=OBSERVE` retained.

comments.text:
12 Oct independent release evidence for Department 2:

- Private staged `mf_zoho_gateway v12.3.24 DEPT2_SECURITY` was recovered and tested without deployment.
- It contains fail-closed SalesIQ webhook signing, prior fail-closed customer order gate, server-cart/idempotency, pre-POST verification, Inventory/Commerce health and protected sourcing-status controls.
- `npm run check` PASS; **167/167 tests PASS**.
- A Department 3 compatibility extension, private v12.3.25, was built directly on this v12.3.24 security source and also preserves the full security suite; **173/173 PASS**.
- Simple source secret-artifact scan found no .env/private-key/log artifacts or token-like values in the staged source tree.
- No production deployment or secret rotation performed in this QA pass.

Observed live Development is currently gateway **v12.3.20** / client **v12.5.14**, so the staged security build is still not demonstrated as live. Keep source-equivalence/deployment receipt as a release gate.

comments.author: yasirkolathur
comments.text:
### Read-only Catalyst API Gateway finding — 12 Oct 2026 (Department 4 coordination)

I inspected **only** Development metadata for the existing Catalyst project `menafoodscustomermiddleware` (`17990000000237407`), org `809407193`, gateway `mf_zoho_gateway`.

- Route **MFAPI** (`/mf-api/{path1:(.*)}` → `/server/mf_zoho_gateway/{path1}`, ANY) returned **no explicit `authentication` field** in Get_API_route.
- Route **MFUser** (`/mf-user/{path1:(.*)}`, ANY) does show `authentication: ["CatalystUserManagement"]`.
- The direct gateway route likewise returned no explicit auth requirement. This is **not proof of exploitation**, because gateway code may enforce sessions, but must be tested with anonymous 401 / non-tenant 403 probes before release.
- The function list still reports `is_deployed:false`, and I could not directly verify the remote Development /mf-api/health endpoint.
- A connected read-only function metadata view exposes sensitive environment configuration values. **No values or tokens are copied here.** Restrict access/observability and review credential rotation through the existing owner-approved security process.

**Request to Department 2:** Confirm actual deployed version/source, enforce session/role/customer/branch checks on all sensitive MFAPI paths, verify signature/replay/auth behavior, reconcile API Gateway auth semantics with web/Android clients, and document sanitized Dev 200/401/403 results. Do not change route targets or secrets blindly; do not create another backend or deploy Production.

Cross-reference Department 4 draft PR #30 and issue #28.

### Live anonymous auth probe — 12 Oct 2026

Read-only probe against current Catalyst Development:
- `GET /mf-api/customer/profile` → **401**
- `GET /mf-api/customer/books-pricing?skus=CR1658` → **401**
- `GET /mf-api/customer/orders` → **401**
- `GET /mf-api/admin/integrations/health` → **401**
- intended public `GET /mf-api/mobile/catalog/products?per_page=1` → **200** with live Commerce data
- `GET /mf-api/sourcing/status` → **404** (route not live in current runtime)

Live health during this sequence reported gateway **v12.3.22**. This provides evidence that sensitive MFAPI customer/admin routes are currently session-gated in code even though API Gateway metadata did not show explicit auth on MFAPI. Still pending: authenticated wrong-business/role 403 probes, logout/session invalidation, SalesIQ signature live proof, and source/deployment equivalence.
